doc: Editable animation (Part 2 §4.3, F and H): a person's words about an animation — what looks wrong, at which moment — and a fresh agent with only the motion workbench's tools (omui mcp: the stage, its motion.* verbs). The outcome is checked on the document the workbench holds (`state`: motion.document's value at a JSON pointer), never on the agent's word. Each task gets a fresh copy of the example.

tasks.goal: When the ball drops it should bounce three times, not twice. Change the animation so it does.
The ball falls too fast: make its drop take one and a half seconds.
Two seconds into the animation, what kind of step is moving the star? Answer with the step's kind as the document names it.
Near the end the star wobbles in too springily when it grows. Calm it: its spring's damping should be 20, and leave everything else as it is.
After the ball lands it moves to the right too quickly. Make that move take one second instead.
